h1: New Year's Eve at Home: Black and Gold Party Finds for a Grown-Up Countdown
intro: Black and gold is the one night of the year this site allows itself a departure from the warm neutrals, and this is that night. Nine pieces, every one read on its live listing on November 23, 2026, chosen for a countdown at home that feels considered rather than decorated.
seo_title: New Year's Eve at Home: Black and Gold Finds for 2027
seo_description: Nine black and gold pieces for a grown-up countdown, from the 2027 foil balloons to the flutes. Ratings, counts and prices verified November 23, 2026.
list_card_line: Nine black and gold pieces for a grown-up countdown at home, with the year where you can see it.

cards.B0GK17R7Y1: Four gold foil digits that read 2027, big enough to carry a wall and light enough to hang in minutes.
cards.B01BXZ1O0K: A black and gold backdrop printed with 2027, the one place in the room where the year is unmistakable.
cards.B01NA6IZ5Q: A black and gold pennant banner that says the words and no digits, so it works again next year.
cards.B00JR5N0JM: Thirty three feet of warm white on a plug, the quiet light that sits under everything else.
cards.B0FQ5F85W7: Two hundred paper dots in gold, black and silver, the five second finish for a table.
cards.B0CVSC4M9T: A hundred gold rim flutes, so the toast at midnight does not depend on finding the glassware.
cards.B09WQVY1HG: Three white porcelain tiers on a brass frame, and the only piece here that holds the food.
cards.B09FHPF82P: A twelve inch brushed gold tray that gathers the candles, the flutes and the confetti together.
cards.B07R9NJWLM: A champagne gold fringe curtain, the backdrop for the photograph everyone takes at midnight.
